name: Detonation: Stable (Ea = 25)
blurb: A steady detonation of the single-step Arrhenius model (gamma 1.2, q = 50, Ea = 25): it should run at the Chapman–Jouguet speed, 6.809, keeping the ZND profile behind its von Neumann spike. Lengths are in half-reaction lengths: n / box cells resolve each.

featured.label: Activation temperature Ea
featured.tip: Activation temperature of the reaction, in units of the unburned gas temperature. Above 25.26 a planar detonation is unstable and pulses. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Overdrive (D / D_CJ)²
featured.tip: Square of the detonation speed over the Chapman–Jouguet speed: 1 is a self-sustained detonation; above it a piston behind would drive it faster. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Burn inside shocks
featured.tip: Let cells the shock detector flags burn (1) or not (0). Suppressing it, as for fronts too thin to resolve, costs a resolved detonation speed: about 5% short of Chapman–Jouguet at 13 cells per half-reaction length, an error that halves with each doubling of resolution. Changing it starts the run again
